name: Raama Finance Limited
about: Raama Finance Limited engages in non-banking financial business in India. It offers short term and long-term leasing, hire purchasing, and secured and unsecured loans. The company is involved in finance and trading of shares and securities, and derivatives. The company was formerly known as Ramchandra Leasing and Finance Limited and changed its name to Raama Finance Limited in February 2026. Raama Finance Limited was incorporated in 1993 and is based in Noida, India.
